title: The Crossroads
subtitle: maxCompletableDependents: 1
description: Three roads lead away from here and only one of them can be walked.
`maxCompletableDependents: 1` lets at most one of this quest's direct dependents
complete -- the others stay locked for good, the moment the first one is done.
It is the cap on a fan-out, where `exclusiveGroup` is a named pact between
siblings. Use whichever reads better: one quest that closes its own roads, or a
group that says the roads close each other.
